name: json_dumps

source.name: Original
source.modifications: Authored for this experiment as a multi-module payload package with JSON conversion, envelopes, text helpers, normalisation and reports.

issue: 序列化 JSON 时三个选项组合不正确，中文等非 ASCII 字符被转义，键的顺序也未排序且分隔符带多余空格。例如只含 name 与 café 的对象期望输出紧凑且保留原字符的文本，实际输出带转义且含空格。请修复该问题，并保持解析、信封结构、文本处理、负载规范化与描述文本的行为不变。
notes: The serialiser escapes non-ASCII text, keeps insertion order and uses spaced separators. The envelope builder shares the same serialiser. Regression tests check round trips and descriptions rather than exact JSON text.
